repairs.quote: Diana Pulls In, Slows by 40/50/60%, and reveals nearby enemies for 2 seconds. If Diana hits at least one enemy champion, she calls to the moon, dealing (200/300/400 + (60% Ability Power)) magic damage plus (35/60/85 + (15% Ability Power)) for each champion pulled beyond the first, up to a max of an additional (175/300/425 + (75% Ability Power)) damage.
